decisions.reason: The ID Vault got a quantified launch announcement and fits the identity-centric super-app core, so its early results probably meet the modest aspiration for a new feature and it costs little to carry.

The identity-bound wallet is only mentioned in passing and overlaps with the dedicated payment framework, which makes it a candidate for consolidation, but it still supports the payments pillar of the platform.

An NFC-tag login authenticator is a peripheral hardware-style niche with only a passing mention and likely falls short of aspiration, so problemistic search would redirect its resources to the core platform.
Its dedicated page signals strategic commitment and that results meet aspirations, as payments is a core component of the super-app ecosystem.
The multi-service mobile app platform is essentially the firm's flagship super-app offering, so dropping it would contradict its strategic direction regardless of its exact label.
Application shielding draws on the firm's decades of app-security expertise, has its own page, and likely earns satisfactory returns from security-sensitive financial clients.
